title: Grade review evidence on a ladder, filter at synthesis, and add the structural smells
action: Adopt the L5 and L6 review practices (per D2 and D4). Review stays user-invoked: nothing here starts a review. Edit expertise/review.md, the SOURCE copied into .bee/expertise/ by regen — never edit .bee/expertise/ by hand. Never rename a cited heading. Do NOT run bee dev regen (wave-barrier). expertise/review.md: extend 'Label uncertainty exactly' in place — the confidence word becomes a rung on a five-step ladder (said, pointed at the line, walked the failure, ran it, reproduced live) plus where the check stopped, and every finding that shows a rung also names its meaning in words so a user never reads a bare number; a claims-table anchor row counts as the second rung and a ran row as the fourth. Add two labelled heuristics to the smell list: Swelling File (a diff that pushes a file toward a size a reader cannot hold) and Dual Path (an old API kept alive with no external consumer). reviewing-reference.md: method step 3 names the one fact the change's safety rests on and its rung, and a P1 fact below the fourth rung is labelled unproven; method step 2 follows the value past symbol search into wire shapes, columns, flags and readers in other languages; the architecture purpose gains the bolted-on test (known on day one, would it look like this) and a named deletion of a branch or mode as a P2 standards finding. bee-reviewing/SKILL.md § The wave: before severity promotion, a lead filter checks each finding against context the reviewers were denied (locked decisions, earlier rejects, planned cells, repo convention) and drops an unreachable finding, a preference with no named failure, or a missing-context finding into Dismissed with what was checked; a reviewer whose findings are all nits is reported as lens clean; a return that breaks the finding schema or cites a path that does not resolve gets one re-dispatch with the failure named, and a second failure is listed as an uncovered lens; the report names each reviewer's dispatched tier above Dismissed and may add one line on which reviewers corroborated which finding; corroboration counts as independent only across different models or disjoint lenses; a bug-fix cell with no red-before proof line is P2 under Verify the artifacts. Cite qualified pointers without the skills/ prefix.
verify: rg -q 'reproduced live' expertise/review.md && rg -q 'Dual Path' expertise/review.md && rg -q 'lens clean' skills/bee-reviewing/SKILL.md
